title: CompoundCreateResult
description: Result of a single compound `bug create` (flag form or single-object `--from-json`) that filed the bug but had at least one sub-step (comment/attachment) fail. Full-success creates emit `action-result` instead, so this body appears only on partial failure (exit 11). The created bug `id` is always present.

id.description: The filed bug's ID — the recovery handle for completing the failed sub-steps.

file.description: Attachment filename, present only when `step` is `attachment`.
